function.name: answer
function.description: Answer the current decision. Every decision is answered with this one call: give the field the decision asks for (one option number, a list of option numbers, blocks, amounts, keep, a number or a card name) and the optional notes it invites. The call ends the decision and the engine carries it out. If the values are not legal for this decision you are told why, nothing happens, and you may call once more. Think before calling; the arguments hold only the answer. Lookups made before it do not count against it.

option.description: For a decision that asks for ONE option from a numbered list: that option's number. A decline/none/PASS option, when listed, is just another number.

options.description: For a decision that asks you to choose several options (or none) from a numbered list (discard, reveal, sacrifice, scry/surveil, attackers): the numbers, in the order you want them, within the minimum and maximum the decision states. An empty list chooses none.

blocks.description: For a declare-blockers decision: each block as a blocker number and an attacker number; each blocker once, or up to the number of attackers its label says it can block. An empty list declares no blocks.

blocker.description: The number of your blocking creature, from the decision's blocker list.

attacker.description: The number of the attacker it blocks, from the decision's attacker list.

amounts.description: For a decision that divides an amount (damage, counters) among listed targets: one number per target, in the order listed, adding up to the stated total.

keep.description: For a mulligan decision: true to keep this hand, false to mulligan.

number.description: For a decision that asks for a number (X, a count): an integer in the range the decision states.

card.description: For a decision that asks you to name a card: its exact English name.

steps.description: Optional, only on a play decision that says it takes `steps`: the CAST/ACTIVATE option numbers of your plan, in order, for the harness to cast without asking again this turn. Omit anything you are holding. Elsewhere it is ignored.

yield.description: Optional, only with PASS on a play decision. "none" (the default): you are asked at every window as usual. "end-of-turn" or "my-next-turn": until then you are not asked in windows where nothing of your opponent's is on the stack (anything they cast or activate always asks you; your own main phase asks again once the stack is empty; end-of-turn lasts through this turn's end step).

profile.description: Optional, when the decision asks for it: your read of the OPPONENT in one short line (their deck and plan, and the cards to respect).

lines.description: Optional, when the decision asks for it: how cards in YOUR OWN deck combine, in one or two short lines.

keep_untapped.description: Optional, on a play decision whose choice casts or activates something with a mana cost: the mana sources to leave UNTAPPED when it is paid, by handle ("@12"), for example to keep blue up for a counterspell. Omit it, or leave it empty, and you are asked when the choice matters.

why.description: Optional: one sentence on why you chose this, kept in the game record for the people reviewing it. It does not change the answer.

function.name: set_plan
function.description: State or replace YOUR plan, a note and not a commitment: it is shown back to you on every later decision with the turn you set it, and each decision is still yours on the state then. Call it whenever the plan no longer fits, at any decision, alongside your answer. It does not answer the decision.

next.description: The steps you intend, in order (e.g. a land, cast a card, hold a card for their turn).
